title: `AppStatus.should_exit` latches to True after any uvicorn server stops, so every later EventSourceResponse in the process is cancelled (regression in 3.1.1)
body: After one uvicorn server stops, a later EventSourceResponse in the same process is cancelled before its first event. This affects test suites and applications that start more than one server over a process lifetime. The report ties the regression to the 3.1.1 shutdown-watcher change and describes AppStatus.should_exit remaining true.
